fit.gap_handling_summary: The CV correctly presents an analytics/data-science candidate transitioning to ML engineering, not an established production ML engineer. It foregrounds the closest genuine evidence: operational forecasting, churn modelling, Python, feature engineering, evaluation and analytics-layer maintenance. BigQuery is relevant cloud-service exposure but does not establish cloud ML deployment experience; dbt maintenance likewise does not establish ingestion, training or serving orchestration. The letter does not meaningfully address the substantial gaps in RAG, MLOps, serving and production engineering.
